title: Concept: Cookie sets SameSite=None without Secure
description: The response sets a cookie with SameSite=None and no Secure attribute. Browsers refuse this combination on paper, which turns into a silently missing session in practice, and older or permissive clients may still store it and send it across sites. Either way the declared policy and the delivered protection differ.
applicability: Any HTTPS response that issues cookies for cross-site use.
risk: Session cookie rejected or sent without the intended isolation; MEDIUM severity.
